'''I-Ming Chen''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 53 from Vista, Ca. The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). '''FL''' on those tables stands for Flight Leader, per [[Ming Huo]] and [[Scott Lingrell]].

== Jedi Knights TCG ==
Chen playtested the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001).<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001).
